title: The Walkthrough
tagline: Follow one made-up request from the words I type to checked, finished work.
what: How I work with AI chats, shown with one made-up request: a search box for my website. My own add-ons around Claude Code carry it through six stops, from the words I type to work that's checked and live.
request: Add a search box to my website
built: Over 60 small add-ons on every chat; around 30 are guards that check an action before it runs
A separate window that asks me before anything risky, one action at a time
Goals that close only on proof: a command's output, a second checker, or my own words
Notes, facts and the last chat's progress attached to every request
credit: Built it on top of Claude Code
starring: Me, and the AI chats I run every day

journey.name: Ask
journey.adds: I type what I want in plain words, the way I'd ask a person.
journey.example: I ask for a search box on my website, and for it to go live once it's ready.

scene.said: Add a search box to my website, and put it live when it's ready.

journey.name: Context arrives
journey.adds: Before the AI reads a word, my setup attaches the notes, settled facts and last chat's progress it needs.
journey.example: It already knows how the site is built, where the last chat stopped, and that nothing goes live without my yes.

scene.to: Add a search box to my website...

journey.name: Rules check
journey.adds: Every action passes small guards. Anything risky stops and asks me in a separate window.
journey.example: Editing the page goes ahead. Putting a password in the code is refused. Putting it live waits for me.

journey.name: Plan and goals
journey.adds: The work becomes a plan with a finish line, and every goal says what proof will close it.
journey.example: Three goals: a search finds the right page, it works on a phone, and it goes live only after I say yes.

scene.title: Search box
goals: A search finds the right page

journey.name: Work, then proof
journey.adds: Helpers, extra AI runs the chat starts, search and read side by side. A checker reopens every source they point to, and nothing closes without evidence.
journey.example: The test passes, a second checker signs off on the phone view, and the last goal waits until I say yes.

journey.name: Handoff
journey.adds: The chat writes where it stopped and what's next, so the next one starts warm.
journey.example: It notes that search is live and filters come next. The next chat opens already knowing that.
